findings.detail: Earlier question M2-S60-T1 has the same scene with only the document type changed (invoices to leases). In both, an extraction system returns JSON in Claude's text reply and syntax errors break the downstream parse. The correct action is also the same: define an extraction tool whose input parameters are the JSON schema and read the data from the tool_use block. Option D nearly restates both correct options of the earlier question.

blind_answer.reason: Tool use with a JSON schema is the most reliable way to get schema-compliant structured output. The arguments come back as structured data in the tool_use block, so JSON syntax errors such as unescaped quotes are eliminated (4.3-K1, 4.3-S1). Few-shot examples, self-review passes and repair scripts are only probabilistic or heuristic fixes and do not guarantee compliance.
